steps.title: 📥 Clone and Install
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/HKUDS/ViMax.git
cd ViMax
uv sync

cp configs/agent.example.yaml configs/agent.local.yaml

vimax tui

vimax tui new
vimax tui resume
vimax tui resume <session_id>

cd web
npm install
npm run dev

ssh -N -L 4173:127.0.0.1:4173 <user>@<server>

VIMAX_WEB_PORT=4174 npm run dev

idea = \
"""
If a cat and a dog are best friends, what would happen when they meet a new cat?
"""
user_requirement = \
"""
For children, do not exceed 3 scenes.
"""
style = "Cartoon"

zh.what: 港大 HKUDS 的 Agent 式视频生成框架，把导演、编剧、制片、分镜、素材生成拆成多个 Agent 协作，最后合成一条叙事完整的视频。相比单次文生视频，它更适合有剧情、有镜头语言的长内容，适合做短片、广告、教学视频的研究者和创作者。
